cases.title: Brightline Supply
cases.question: Should we prepay Brightline Supply 50 percent on a six-month packaging contract, and on what terms?

evidence.text: State registry entry The state registry lists Brightline Supply LLC as active, formed in 2016. Annual reports filed on time every year. Secretary of State extract registry Brightline Supply vendor file

risk_questions.title: Delivery reliability risk
risk_questions.statement: The vendor is real and solvent but misses delivery dates in peak season.

risk_questions.title: Shell company or fraud
risk_questions.statement: The vendor is not a real operating business and the prepayment would be lost.

risk_questions.title: Financial distress
risk_questions.statement: The vendor is short of cash and may not survive the contract term.

risk_questions.title: No material risk
risk_questions.statement: The vendor is established and reliable, so standard prepayment terms are fine.

cases.title: Corvid Retail
cases.question: Records conflict on whether Corvid Retail is still trading. Should we ship a 40,000 dollar first order on 60-day terms?

evidence.text: State registry entry The state registry lists Corvid Retail LLC as dissolved in June 2025. Secretary of State extract registry Corvid Retail credit file
Successor registration A new entity, Corvid Retail Holdings LLC, registered in July 2025 at the same address and with the same manager. Secretary of State extract registry Corvid Retail credit file

Trade references Two trade references say invoices were paid within terms in 2026. Reference calls references Corvid Retail credit file

risk_questions.title: Trading through a successor entity
risk_questions.statement: The old company dissolved and the business now trades through a new entity at the same address.

risk_questions.title: Phoenix company
risk_questions.statement: The owners dissolved the company to walk away from its debts and restarted under a new name.

risk_questions.title: Slow payer
risk_questions.statement: The customer is real but pays well beyond terms.

risk_questions.title: Healthy customer
risk_questions.statement: The customer is established and pays on time, so 60-day terms are fine.

risk_questions.title: Related-party round trip
risk_questions.statement: The revenue spike is supported by a related-party customer that shares the target registered agent, so the quarter may be circular.

risk_questions.title: Bill-and-hold channel stuffing
risk_questions.statement: The target billed revenue on bill-and-hold terms without a matching rise in throughput or cash.

risk_questions.title: Legitimate seasonal demand
risk_questions.statement: The quarter is a real seasonal demand peak from a new independent contract.

risk_questions.title: Telematics integration defect
risk_questions.statement: The miles decline is a broken telematics integration, not weaker operating throughput.
